newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-SAQLAIN TAKES FIVE WICKETS IN TOUR WIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SAQLAIN TAKES FIVE WICKETS IN TOUR WIN.

text.p: Pakistan off-spinner Saqlain Mushtaq took five wickets to steer the tourists to a 25-run victory over Hunter Invitation XI in a rain-hit limited-overs tour match on Monday.
Pakistan scored 186 for nine in their quota of 32 overs before dismissing the home side for 161 in 31.2 overs.
The match was reduced to 32 overs a side after more than three hours of play were lost because of rain.
Number three batsman Zahoor Elahi laid the platform for the victory with a hard-hitting innings of 69 and sharing a fourth-wicket stand of 117 with Inzamam-ul-Haq.
Inzamam, batting at number five, contributed a rapid 55 as the tourists scored at a rate of almost six runs an over at the Newcastle Sports Ground.
Saqlain routed the middle order to finish with bowling figures of five for 28 as Hunter Invitation XI, a team dominated by New South Wales players, were dismissed with four balls remaining.
Pakistan face Australia in the World Series limited-overs competition in Sydney on Wednesday.
